title: 3D Sound Environment
description: Set up a scene with a moving Audio Listener and multiple 3D sound sources to experience spatial audio.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Create a simple demo to hear 3D audio in action.

1. Create a new scene. Add a Plane as ground.
2. Create a Sphere (Audio Emitter) at position (0, 0, 5). Attach an Audio Source to it.
   - Import a looping sound (or use a short sound with Loop = true).
   - Set Spatial Blend = 1 (3D).
   - Min Distance = 1, Max Distance = 10.
   - Play On Awake and Loop = true.
3. Create a Capsule (Player) with Rigidbody and an Audio Listener. Add a movement script (WASD) so you can move it.
   - Move the Audio Listener from the Main Camera to the Capsule; disable the one on the Camera.
4. Test: in Play mode, move the Capsule around the Sphere. You'll hear the sound get louder as you approach, and pan left/right as you circle it.
5. (Optional) Add a second Sphere at a different location with a different sound to hear multiple sources.

Take a screenshot of the Scene view showing the Audio Source's 3D settings and the capsule position.
hints: Make sure the Capsule has an Audio Listener component; remove it from the Main Camera if it's still there.
To visualize the sound range, select the Audio Source in Scene view; you'll see wire spheres for min/max distance.
expectedOutput: Moving the player causes volume and stereo pan changes based on distance and direction.
